property_summary: For every input where _tos.length > 0, calling transfer(...) always completes without reverting (returns true); the mutant's off-by-one loop can access out-of-bounds and cause transfer(...) to revert for some inputs (e.g., non-empty arrays), breaking that property.
change_summary: Change the loop condition from i < _tos.length to i <= _tos.length, causing an out-of-bounds access and likely revert on certain inputs.
